description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) and constants related to routing form workflows, including classes for workflow steps, triggers, activation, and overall workflow output, used in a NestJS-based API.

classes.name: RoutingFormWorkflowStepOutputDto
classes.description: DTO representing a step in the routing form workflow, including the action to perform.

classes.name: RoutingFormWorkflowTriggerOutputDto
classes.description: DTO representing the trigger configuration for the workflow, including type and optional offset.

classes.name: RoutingFormWorkflowActivationOutputDto
classes.description: DTO representing activation settings for the workflow, including whether active on all forms and specific form IDs.

classes.name: RoutingFormWorkflowOutput
classes.description: Main DTO representing a routing form workflow, including type, activation, trigger, and steps.

classes.name: GetRoutingFormWorkflowsOutput
classes.description: Response DTO for listing multiple workflows, including status and data.

classes.name: GetRoutingFormWorkflowOutput
classes.description: Response DTO for a single workflow query, including status and data.
